# WAF v2

Persist scoped web ACLs, IP sets, rule groups, tags and regional association metadata without inspecting traffic.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `wafv2` |
| Signing name | `wafv2` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2019-07-29` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 22 of 59 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#waf-v2) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only: no request evaluation, filtering, ingress integration, network enforcement, sampled requests, CloudWatch metrics, CAPTCHA/challenges, logging engine or runtime counters; VisibilityConfig is stored requested metadata.
- Only aws commercial partition and the finite commercial Region allowlist in internal/services/wafv2/service.go; CLOUDFRONT outside us-east-1 fails. Global associations through CloudFront distribution workflows are not implemented.
- Association ResourceArn supports only arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:REGION:ACCOUNT:loadbalancer/app/NAME/16-hex-ID and arn:aws:apigateway:REGION::/restapis/10-character-ID/stages/STAGE. These are format-only metadata, without owning-service lookup; accountless API Gateway ARNs are stored under the caller account.
- No managed rule groups, rate, regex, byte/geo/size/SQL/XSS/label match or composite statements; forwarded IP configuration, excluded rules, rule action overrides, labels, custom responses/request headers, data protection and advanced ACL/group fields are rejected even when null, false or empty.
- Rule-group Capacity is declared metadata (1-5000), preserved by updates; no WCU estimation, capacity consumption output or CheckCapacity. At most 50 direct reference rules per ACL/group and 100 records of each type per account/Region/scope.
- Names support 1-128 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen. Descriptions use the exact pinned pattern and 256-character limit; metric names use the pinned pattern and 1-255 limit, excluding All and Default_Action. IPv4-mapped IPv6 CIDRs are rejected; CIDRs are preserved as supplied.
- Update requests provide complete selected desired state; omitted description/rules clear those fields. Family and capacity cannot be updated through the WAF APIs. Deleting referenced IP sets/groups or associated ACLs returns WAFAssociatedItemException.
- CloudFormation properties are Name/Scope/Description/Tags plus Addresses/IPAddressVersion for IPSet, Rules/VisibilityConfig/Capacity for RuleGroup, Rules/VisibilityConfig/DefaultAction for WebACL, and ResourceArn/WebACLArn for associations. Configuration name/scope and IP family/group capacity changes require replacement; Arn and Id are the only configuration GetAtt attributes.
- CloudFormation tag updates are a local extension to the AWS documentation creation-only note: unrelated live tags remain, removals free capacity before replacement and failed tag/configuration calls compensate. No mutation console or additional WAFv2 resources.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
